primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Orientation; printed p.14, PDF pp.29–29
primary_records.original_meaning: Describes orientation in world space, distinct from Attached Orientation (physical parent) and Local Orientation (own home frame). The entry labels the frame Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed and also describes x toward true north, y to the component's right and z down along gravity.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Preserve both source statements. Do not silently choose a frame identifier, axis transform, quaternion conversion, or reinterpret this as Attached/Local Orientation. Required yaw/pitch/roll and the Rotation sequence are recorded; an interoperable numeric frame mapping needs resolution of ISA-Q003.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Perceived Position; printed p.14, PDF pp.29–30
primary_records.proposed_label: Hardware-reported position while position is overridden
primary_records.original_meaning: Reports position from hardware when Position is being overridden by Position Override. The property is optional and is not required when providing the override capability.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Do not require this field solely because an override is supported. Hardware-reported does not mean independently surveyed, unmodified raw GNSS data or true probe location. No actual override or case coordinate is inferred.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Position; printed p.15, PDF pp.30–30
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported current geographic position of the component
primary_records.original_meaning: Reports the current position of the component using Geographic Position: required latitude/longitude and optional altitude and error-ellipsoid attributes under the source's stated conventions.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not automatically the position of an attached probe, a platform, a feature of interest, or a measurement event. Preserve component identity, the stated vertical convention and missing-value semantics; do not invent precision, surveyed accuracy, Cartesian coordinates or observation time.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Position Override; printed p.15, PDF pp.30–30
primary_records.proposed_label: Position value used to override hardware-perceived position
primary_records.original_meaning: Provides the property used to override a perceived position from hardware, using the Geographic Position structure.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: A declared override property does not prove that override is currently active, who set it, authorization, physical movement or a more accurate position. Do not conflate it with hardware Perceived Position, ordinary Position, or a boolean override-state indicator.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Meters; printed p.53; PDF pp.68–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Linear-distance Float type; native range is not assumed from the property label.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Degrees; printed p.52; PDF pp.67–67
DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Degrees; printed p.98; PDF pp.113–114
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Degrees; optional error:Degrees with plus/minus one-standard-deviation meaning; definition continues across pages.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Rotation; printed p.111; PDF pp.126–127
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Original pp.111–112/PDF126–127 text checked: required pitch, roll and yaw as Measured Degrees; yaw about z, then pitch about new y', then roll about new x''. Source states positive clockwise viewed from origin. This sequence does not resolve Orientation's named-frame versus axis-description question.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Position; printed p.95; PDF pp.110–110
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Original PDF p.110 image and text checked: required latitude/longitude in Degrees; optional altitude in Meters with source geoid/EGM96 statement and At Ground Level default; optional a/b/c axes and phi/theta angles with source zero defaults. These defaults are not measured accuracy, a supplied height, or ellipsoidal-height conversion. Keep the source ECEF label separate from its latitude/longitude field structure.

new_question.known: World-space orientation is distinct from parent/home-frame orientation. DMS names Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed while describing true-north/right/gravity-down axes; Rotation specifies yaw/pitch/roll and order.
new_question.question: Which precise reference frame and axis interpretation governs numeric Orientation values when reconciling the source's named frame with its stated axes?
new_question.decision: Keep Orientation and its Rotation type visible as a spatial candidate; preserve both original statements. Do not invent a frame identifier or coordinate transformation.
new_question.evidence: DMS §3.1 p.14/PDF29; Rotation §8.3 pp.111–112/PDF126–127. Geographic Position §8.3 p.95/PDF110 read for position-field/altitude conventions.
new_question.next_resolution: ISA-10 Rotation full-type pass and an ISA-11 spatial-guidance reconciliation sub-batch: check original companion guidance or an authoritative clarification before specifying a numeric transformation. No rereview of the three completed position-property meanings.
